correctness.rationale: Ohashi gives the smoothness and quotient geometry. Direct coefficient calculation gives elliptic Hasse polynomials B(B²−AC) in F7. SymPy confirms the Rabinowitsch-saturated lex Groebner basis and exactly 23 standard monomials; exact GF49 arithmetic exhibits 23 distinct smooth Hasse zeros, four orbits, and nonzero Jacobian determinants at each. Thus the 23-length scheme is exactly those reduced points and three Hasse hypersurfaces are transverse. Kani–Rosen 2-power isogeny identifies 7-divisible groups, establishing superspecial equivalence. Neither finite enumeration nor computations alone are treated as an infinite-field bound.

value.rationale: This gives a complete exact, nontrivial natural intersection cycle of three quotient-Hasse divisors in a genus-three arithmetic family. Reducedness and transversality quantify infinitesimal deformation conditions and rule out hidden multiplicities; neither is decided by set-theoretic superspeciality classification or previously known Fp² rationality. A reproducible 23-point finite cut-off and clear symmetry-orbit decomposition make the result independently usable without overstating geometric isomorphism classification.
